Context: 1. T.A. and Joining Time

- Appendix 10, Note 2 below Rule 5.  
- (c) Road mileage for transportation of personal effects.Higher rate of allowance as for 'X' class cities, limited to the actual expenditure, will be admissible to all Government servants for transportation of personal effects on transfer between two different stations in the North-Eastern Region/ Union Territory not connected by rail irrespective of the fact whether they are having All India transfer liability or not.
